info.title: lineup
info.description: IPTV channel and playlist manager: M3U playlists and XMLTV guides over HTTP

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring of name, tvg-id, source or identity.

parameters.name: health
parameters.description: Only channels whose last conclusive check result is this (`ok` or `dead`).

post.summary:
Create a channel. Its input is validated with the route (a gateway route asks its gateway);
502 when the gateway fails.

patch.summary: Update a channel. `route_id` and/or `input` revalidate its source with the route.

get.summary: Stored check results and what the route's gateway observes now (never starts a stream).

post.summary:
Check channels through their routes' gateways. With `ids`, waits and returns their results
(409 if a channel's route has no checks); without, starts a run over all enabled channels of
routes with checks in the background (202).

get.summary: Channels offered by the enabled sources. With `q`, the best matches first.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search text: matched against channel ids and display names.

post.summary:
Fetch sources now and wait for the result. Fetches run one at a time, so this waits for any fetch
already running.
Adds a source and starts fetching it in the background.

patch.summary:
A URL change keeps the current guide data until the new URL's first successful fetch, which starts
immediately.

post.summary:
Send a synthetic `hook.test` event now (one attempt, no debounce) and return the logged result.
For a Jellyfin hook this really starts a guide refresh.
Validate an input with a route and suggest channel metadata; nothing is written.
Create a route. Its kind and (for gateway routes) its rule can't change later.

Test a route config (saved or not), and optionally an input with it. Runs from the lineup
server; it cannot show whether players reach the same address.

delete.summary: Delete a route; 409 while channels use it.

patch.summary:
Rename, enable or disable a route, or change a gateway route's base URL. A base URL change
revalidates every channel against the new address first and is refused (409) if any fails.

post.summary:
Revalidate every channel of a gateway route with its gateway and publish the changes. Channels
that fail keep their values and are listed.

get.summary: The saved route's gateway, live: whether it answers, its rule and channels pending a resync.

Availability.description: Whether a feature is available, and why not.

reason.description: Why it is unavailable (null when available).

playlists.description: Slugs of playlists containing this channel.

route_enabled.description:
Whether the channel's route is enabled. Channels of a disabled route stay listed but are
left out of playlists and guides.

source.description: Canonical source, as the route validated it.

input.description: What to play, in a form the route accepts (a URL for Direct; the gateway rule's input).

playlists.description: Playlists (by slug) to append the new channel to.

route_id.description: The route that plays the channel.

ChannelHealth.description: Check results of a channel. Only `ok` and `dead` are conclusive.

oneOf.description: Last conclusive result (`ok` or `dead`); drives the badge and events.
Content state reported by the last attempt.

detail.description: Gateway details of the last attempt.

reason.description: Why the last attempt was `unknown` or `skipped` (e.g. `busy`).

ChannelInfo.description: What lineup can tell about a channel right now, beyond its stored fields.

checks.description: Whether "Check now" can run for this channel.

oneOf.description: Latest check result and last conclusive result (null until checked).
Null when the route can't observe (Direct, or a rule without `observe`).

observation_error.description: Why there is no observation although the route supports it (e.g. the gateway is unreachable).

ChannelPatch.description:
Partial update. Absent fields are left unchanged; for nullable fields, `null` clears.
`route_id` and/or `input` revalidate the source (with the current source when only the route
changes).

force.description: Check even if the channel seems to be in use.

ids.description:
Channels to check; all enabled channels of routes that support checks when empty (that run
continues in the background).

background.description:
True when a run over all channels was started in the background; results then arrive as
channel updates and events.

results.description: Results, when specific channels were checked.

recorded.description:
False when the result was not stored (the channel or its route changed meanwhile, or the
check did not run).

ContentState.description: What a page source currently is, when the gateway can tell.

EpgChannel.description: A channel offered by a guide source.

score.description: Match score in [0, 1] when the list came from a search.

source_ids.description: Sources to fetch; all enabled sources when empty.

channels.description: Channels in the published generation (when updated).

programmes.description: Programmes kept in the published generation (when updated).

current_gen.description: Generation being served; null until the first successful fetch.

priority.description: When several sources carry the same channel id, the highest priority wins.

code.description:
Stable machine-readable code: not_found, conflict, invalid, internal, gateway_unreachable,
gateway_error, contract_mismatch.

Fact.description: A labelled value reported by a gateway, for display.

Hints.description: Suggestions a gateway gives for a source.

debounce_secs.description: Events are collected until none has arrived for this long, then delivered together.

oneOf.description: Sends the event envelope as JSON to a URL (e.g. a media server's refresh endpoint).

headers.description: Extra request headers. Values are write-only: responses show a mask.

HookConfig.description: What a hook calls. Tagged by `kind` so other kinds can be added later; today only webhooks.

attempt.description: 1 for the first try; retries count up.

ok.description: The receiver answered 2xx (accepted; not a guarantee that it finished).

oneOf.description: Replaces the whole config; masked secrets sent back unchanged keep their stored values.

diff.description: Fields where the file differs from the existing channel (existing metadata is never overwritten).

skipped_lines.description: Lines that could not be parsed into an entry.

route_id.description: The route every entry is validated with. Entries it does not accept are skipped and listed.

position.description: 1-based insert position; appended when absent or beyond the end.

channel_ids.description: Full new order of channel ids.

Observation.description: What the route's gateway reports about a channel right now. Reading it never starts a stream.

reason.description: Why not, or why some values are missing.

title.description: The source's current title, when it reports one.

watching.description: Whether someone is watching through the gateway's services, when known.

slugs.description: Playlists to refresh; all when absent or empty.

duplicate_of.description: Existing channel on this route with the same identity, if any.

duplicate_source.description:
The duplicate's stored source, when it differs from this one (e.g. a newer access token);
editing that channel with this input updates it.

matches.description: Best guide channels for the suggested name, best first (up to 5).

suggestion.description: Suggested values for a new channel; shown as editable defaults.

ResyncReport.description: Outcome of revalidating every channel of a route.

complete.description: Every channel is now current (the route's synced revisions advanced).

failed.description:
Channels the gateway did not accept, or that would collide with another channel; they keep
their previous values.

skipped.description: Channels changed by someone else during the resync; left as they are.

updated.description: Channels whose source, identity or play reference changed.

revision.description: Increases with every change; of two copies, the higher revision is newer. Read-only.

synced_match_revision.description: The rule's match revision at the last resync that updated every channel (gateway only).

synced_play_revision.description: The rule's play revision at the last resync that updated every channel (gateway only).

oneOf.description: Channels are stream URLs, emitted as they are.
A gateway service turns channel sources into play URLs.

base_url.description: Gateway base URL, as players reach it (e.g. `http://media-host:8099`).

RouteConfig.description:
How a route plays its channels. Tagged by `kind`; the kind and a gateway's rule can't change
after the route is created.

RoutePatch.description: Partial update. The kind and a gateway's rule can't change; create another route instead.

base_url.description:
New gateway base URL. Every channel of the route is revalidated against it first; if any
fails, nothing changes.

RouteStatus.description: Live state of a route's gateway (from the saved config).

ok.description: The gateway answered and has the route's rule.

pending_channels.description:
Channels whose play reference is from another play revision than the gateway's current one
(they need a resync). Null when the gateway did not answer.

oneOf.description: The route's rule as the gateway describes it now.

RouteTestRequest.description: Test a route config before (or without) saving it.

input.description: Also validate this input with the config.

detail.description: What the test shows, or why it failed.

oneOf.description: The gateway's self-description (gateway configs that answered).
How the input validated, when one was given and the route works.

RuleSummary.description: A gateway rule, as the gateway describes it.

Settings.description: App-wide settings. Service addresses live in the routes.

check_interval_hours.description:
Hours between scheduled checks of all enabled channels on routes that support checks (the
first runs 10 minutes after start); 0 turns them off.

epg_refresh_hours.description: Hours between scheduled EPG fetches (the first runs 3 minutes after start); 0 turns the schedule off.

revision.description:
Increases with every change; of two copies of the settings, the higher revision is newer.
Read-only.

ValidatedSource.description: A source as a route validated it.

source.description: Canonical source, stored with the channel.
